products.name: Classic Fruit Mix
products.description: Seven fruits in one bag, including strawberry, mango, apple and banana. Add a few pieces just before serving for a fruit topping.
products.alt: OhCrisp Classic Fruit Mix product photograph

products.name: Exotic Fruit Discovery Mix
products.description: A seven-fruit mix with lychee, fig, pineapple, coconut, jackfruit, dragon fruit and mango. Explore several flavors in a single bag.
products.alt: OhCrisp Exotic Fruit Discovery Mix product photograph

products.name: Individually Wrapped Whole Bananas
products.description: Whole freeze-dried bananas in individual wrappers. Open one for a snack, or break a portion into pieces for your bowl.
products.alt: OhCrisp individually wrapped whole freeze-dried banana product photograph

buyer-guide.title: See the formats at OhCrisp
buyer-guide.intro: Compare a mixed-fruit bag with an individually wrapped single-fruit format. Use the product pages to check current ingredients, pack size and availability.

best-freeze-dried-fruit-for-oatmeal-and-.title: Choose a fruit topping for your next bowl
best-freeze-dried-fruit-for-oatmeal-and-.intro: Classic Mix offers several fruits in one bag; a whole banana lets you add one fruit at a time. Add pieces just before eating when you want topping contrast. These are product examples, not results from a comparative recipe test.
